categories.main_business_segments: Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd. primarily operates in the production and marketing of seasonings including soy sauce, oyster sauce, seasoning sauces, vinegar, cooking wine, and various compound seasonings. The company also engages in the production of soy products, food, beverages, packaging materials, and agricultural product processing. It has a comprehensive product portfolio serving both household and commercial culinary needs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes traditional fermentation and brewing techniques combined with modern intelligent manufacturing technologies. It utilizes AI-based raw material inspection such as AI soybean face recognition and an innovative 'intelligent nose' sensory system for flavor control. The production process is highly automated, digitalized, and lean-managed, with advanced flexible production lines and smart factory initiatives, including being recognized as a 'Lighthouse Factory' by the World Economic Forum.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haitian primarily serves distributors and end consumers in the food seasoning market. Its products are widely used in households and the foodservice industry across China. The company also targets diverse consumer segments with products catering to health-conscious and specialty dietary needs. It is expanding its international presence to promote Chinese flavors globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Guangdong, Jiangsu, Guangxi, Hubei, and other provinces. It has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong, Vietnam, Indonesia, and other international locations, supporting its global expansion strategy. Domestic sales are well distributed across eastern, southern, central, northern, and western regions of China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haitian operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and distribution of seasoning products. It controls upstream raw material quality through direct involvement in soybean planting and procurement, ensuring supply chain integration and optimization. The company also manages logistics and warehousing to support its extensive distribution network.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes user-centric innovation, integrating demand insight, product innovation, quality control, and service optimization. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on fermentation core technologies, strain selection, brewing equipment, and precision testing. Haitian pursues digital transformation and smart manufacturing to enhance operational efficiency and product quality. Sustainability and green production are also strategic pillars, with ongoing efforts in low-carbon technologies and eco-friendly product development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales to distributors and direct customers. The company employs a predominantly dealer-based sales model supplemented by direct sales and digital marketing channels. It also earns income from logistics services and financial investments. Government subsidies and investment income contribute marginally to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haitian is the leading player in China's seasoning industry, holding the top market share in soy sauce, oyster sauce, seasoning sauces, and vinegar categories. It is recognized as the industry leader with a strong brand presence and comprehensive product portfolio. Competitors include other domestic seasoning manufacturers, but Haitian's scale, technology, and brand equity position it as the dominant market leader.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Haitian reported revenues of approximately RMB 26.9 billion, a 9.53% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 6.34 billion, up 12.75%. Total assets reached RMB 40.86 billion with net assets of RMB 30.9 billion. The company maintains a strong net profit margin of 23.63% and continues to invest significantly in R&D (3.12% of revenue). It has a stable and growing financial profile with consistent profitability and expanding market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haitian emphasizes high-quality, authentic traditional brewing combined with modern intelligent manufacturing to deliver products with superior flavor, nutrition, and safety. It offers a broad and diversified product range catering to various consumer needs, including organic, low-sodium, and specialty dietary products. The company leverages scale advantages for cost efficiency, ensuring high cost-performance products. Its commitment to sustainability, innovation, and user-centric service differentiates it in the competitive seasoning market.
